lead: `cargo test -p nvs-cli --lib` is `error: no library targets found in package`, and the unit tests it was meant to run are in the bin target.
body: `nvs-cli` has no `lib.rs`, so a module's `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` runs under `cargo test --bin nvs <filter>`, and `crates/nvs-cli/tests/*.rs` drive the built binary instead of linking to anything. The same is true of every binary-only crate here.
